command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp

echo "== verify staged reads against their pinned sha256 (same bytes bwa used) =="
{ printf '%s  %s\n' 4bd24cdfa4486964f070e69b5dd109b6e1e78561783d48c4e62cc6fae3536a00 HG00096_chr20smoke_1.fq.gz
  printf '%s  %s\n' ebd1ad56bc572a4bf157ba21d1ad8ef074ea25f02eb2d982d9f0089180d82a04 HG00096_chr20smoke_2.fq.gz
} > pins.sha256
sha256sum -c pins.sha256

echo "== fastp QC + trim, paired-end =="
fastp -i HG00096_chr20smoke_1.fq.gz -I HG00096_chr20smoke_2.fq.gz \
      -o out_1.fq.gz -O out_2.fq.gz -j fastp.json -h fastp.html -w 2 2> fastp.log
# Do NOT rm the staged reads (sticky /tmp -> EPERM, which `rm -f` does not suppress and
# would kill the task under set -e). They are inputs owned by the instance user.

# ---- smoke check (inside the task; no python/jq in this image, parse with awk/grep) ----
getnum() { grep -oE "\"$1\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*[0-9]+" fastp.json | head -1 | grep -oE '[0-9]+$'; }
BEFORE=$(getnum total_reads)            # first total_reads = summary.before_filtering
PASSED=$(getnum passed_filter_reads)
LOWQ=$(getnum low_quality_reads)
MANYN=$(getnum too_many_N_reads)
SHORT=$(getnum too_short_reads)
LONG=$(getnum too_long_reads)
ACCOUNTED=$((PASSED + LOWQ + MANYN + SHORT + LONG))
OUT1=$(( $(gzip -dc out_1.fq.gz | wc -l) / 4 ))
OUT2=$(( $(gzip -dc out_2.fq.gz | wc -l) / 4 ))
OUTSUM=$((OUT1 + OUT2))

{
  echo "reads_before        $BEFORE   want exactly 800000  (400k pairs x2)"
  echo "passed_filter       $PASSED   (observed 748116)"
  echo "low_quality         $LOWQ   (observed 51656)"
  echo "too_many_N          $MANYN   (observed 228)"
  echo "too_short           $SHORT   (observed 0)"
  echo "too_long            $LONG   (observed 0)"
  echo "accounted_for       $ACCOUNTED   want == reads_before ($BEFORE)  [CONSERVATION]"
  echo "out1_reads          $OUT1"
  echo "out2_reads          $OUT2   want == out1 (paired stays paired)"
  echo "out1+out2           $OUTSUM   want == passed_filter ($PASSED)"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt

test "$BEFORE"   -eq 800000
test "$ACCOUNTED" -eq "$BEFORE"
test "$OUT1"     -eq "$OUT2"
test "$OUTSUM"   -eq "$PASSED"
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
